Enclosed please find the receipt for the amount paid n tull. Please forwaro

papers

to the county clerk before Friday. We received forty-two crates of apples on the ninth of March, 1914. Kindly

your obedient servant. The committee will meet again on Tuesday

evening.

Escaneado con CamScanne
